NICE NG45 (2016) for elective surgery, summarised. Yes = offer; Consider = depends on the patient; No = not routinely. Always check the current NICE guideline ↗ and local policy.

Minor surgery

e.g. excising a skin lesion, draining a breast abscess

TestASA 1ASA 2ASA 3–4
FBCNoNoNo
ClottingNoNoNo
Kidney functionNoNoConsider if AKI risk
ECGNoNoConsider if none in last 12 months
Lung function / ABGNoNoNo

Intermediate surgery

e.g. inguinal hernia, varicose veins, tonsillectomy, knee arthroscopy

TestASA 1ASA 2ASA 3–4
FBCNoNoConsider if cardiovascular or renal disease with new symptoms
ClottingNoNoConsider if chronic liver disease
Kidney functionNoConsider if AKI riskYes
ECGNoConsider if cardiovascular, renal or diabetic diseaseYes
Lung function / ABGNoNoConsider senior advice if respiratory disease

Major or complex surgery

e.g. hysterectomy, TURP, discectomy, thyroidectomy, joint replacement, lung or colonic resection

TestASA 1ASA 2ASA 3–4
FBCYesYesYes
ClottingNoNoConsider if chronic liver disease
Kidney functionConsider if AKI riskYesYes
ECGConsider if over 65 and none in last 12 monthsYesYes
Lung function / ABGNoNoConsider senior advice if respiratory disease

Other tests

  • HbA1c: people with diabetes not tested in the last 3 months
  • Pregnancy: ask everyone who could be pregnant on the day; test with consent if in doubt
  • Echo: not routine; consider with a murmur plus cardiac symptoms, or heart failure (ECG first, discuss with an anaesthetist)
  • Chest X-ray, urine dipstick, sickle cell test: not routine (ask about sickle cell history)
  • Anticoagulants: plan individually; DOAC effect can't be measured routinely
